# validate/missing_auth — spec that references an undeclared state field
# produces an error-severity diagnostic on stdout and exits 1.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.missing_field}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}
    events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
auth.bearer.token.ref: error: ref "state.missing_field": state field "missing_field" is not declared under state:
